headline: 1709 FIELDSTONE JUST RETURNED ITS THIRD STRAIGHT NO, AND ALL THREE BLAME THE SAME THING — SIZE AND LAYOUT, NEVER THE PRICE. Seven tours in eight days across five brokerages, and every price field on every form has come back blank while the buyers keep saying the house is not shaped the way they pictured. That is a photography-and-copy problem you can fix this week without touching the number — and it is a far cheaper fix than the price cut this traffic level would normally argue for.

hotSignals.signal: Mallory W. · ARC Realty Vestavia filed interested YES · priced JUST RIGHT · "Client loves the space and the fact that it has room for washer and dryer" — and phoned three minutes earlier to say her client "really, really liked it" and "wants to put an offer in" but needs to save a little more for the down payment, asking to be told if any other offer arrives. ⭐ STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THE BOARD. ✅ AND SHE IS WARM, NOT COLD — she returned your call at 6:00 Tuesday evening with a self-declared twenty-five-minute window, so the relationship is live.
hotSignals.action: Call her — do not email. The written follow-up has been a staged draft for three days and went missing from the queue entirely once. The question to ask is what specifically gets her buyer to the table: timing, possession, or help at closing. She asked to be warned about competition, which means she intends to compete.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE PRICE MOVED AND THE MARKET ANSWERED THE SAME AFTERNOON. The MLS line read $299,000 in Monday night's seller report; Tuesday's 1:50 PM notice reads $295,000 · ACTIVE on the same MLS ID — and that notice IS a booking, Thursday 8/6 at 11:00 AM, the first fresh appointment this listing has taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong. ⭐ Sequence, not proven causation, but it is the sequence you wanted.
hotSignals.action: Tomorrow morning is the test of whether the cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. Chase the feedback on this one within the hour of the 11:00 tour — it is the single most informative read you will get this week.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER SIDE CALLED TO ASK ABOUT COMPETING OFFERS. An assistant to the agent who showed it Monday evening asked at 8:30 that night whether any offers are in or expected. ⭐ Agents do not ask that about houses their buyers are lukewarm on. ⭐ The sellers' own doorbell camera corroborates it — the mother was heard saying she loved it repeatedly and talking about the grass. ⚠️ STILL UNANSWERED after two days, and it is the only live buyer thread on a listing taking a tour a day.
hotSignals.action: Answer it today, honestly, in either direction. "No offers yet" is a perfectly good answer and it forces a decision; silence just lets them drift to the next house. This is the one thread on this listing that could still produce paper.

upcoming: 📅 TODAY — Wed 8/5 — 195 LAKE VIEW CIRCLE, Riverside. HOME INSPECTION. ⭐ This is the last real contingency on your cleanest file: close receipted 8/31, contract-to-close packet delivered Monday, title confirmed receipt inside the hour. ✅ NOTHING IS OWED BY YOUR SIDE. Two documents landed Tuesday and neither touches your sellers' net — the dotloop addendum is an ADDRESS CORRECTION (the title file had been running "Lake View Dr" against a Cir property) and the client-care fee disclosed that afternoon is payable by the BUYER. Have both answers ready before either seller calls you.

📅 TOMORROW — Thu 8/6 11:00 AM — 355 COMANCHE STREET, Montevallo. 🔥 THE FIRST BOOKING SINCE THE PRICE CAME DOWN, confirmed on the same notice that carried the new number. $295,000 · ACTIVE re-verified on that notice. ⭐ Chase this feedback hard — it tells you whether the cut worked.

⚠️ THAT IS THE ENTIRE FORWARD CALENDAR — one inspection and one showing. Every other confirmed appointment in the fourteen-day window has already run. ⭐ WHICH MEANS THE LISTINGS CARRYING LIVE INTEREST — Altamont, Comanche and Rena — all need a PHONE CALL rather than a booking. Nothing on this board converts itself between now and Thursday morning.

Seven tours in eight days across five brokerages on a house that took exactly one showing in its first eleven days — and three consecutive buyers have now rejected it for the same reason. They like the house and reject its SHAPE. ⭐ NOBODY HAS TOUCHED THE PRICE: every price and price-recommendation field on all three reads came back blank. ⭐ THAT MAKES THIS A MARKETING PROBLEM, NOT A PRICING ONE — if the photography and copy promise a bigger, more open house than the floor plan delivers, that mismatch is what is burning six clear-outs a week on owner-occupants. Re-shooting the wide angles and naming the layout honestly in the copy costs a fraction of a price cut and is the correct first move. 🔥 The Monday 6:15 competing-offer question is still the hottest live thread and is still unanswered.
